name: Decimate Mesh
explanation_long: Simplifies a mesh by reducing the number of faces while preserving materials, UVs and textures. This is useful for reducing file size and improving performance by reducing memory usage.
explanation: Simplifies a mesh by reducing the number of faces while preserving materials, UVs and textures. This is useful for reducing file size and improving performance by reducing memory usage.

exposed_options.name: Face Target
exposed_options.description: The target amount of faces (triangles), default is 200,000 triangles.

exposed_options.name: Deviation Percentage
exposed_options.description: Target percentage of deviation relative to the original mesh. Works in conjunction with face target as a cap, depending on deviation the final face count can be lower or equal to the face count.

exposed_options.name: Size on Screen Target
exposed_options.description: Calculates optimal mesh and texture resolution for a given display size on screen in pixel. This method is optional and can work standalone or in conjunction with other targets. Default is 0 (=off).

exposed_options.name: Preserve Mesh Normals
exposed_options.description: Preserves vertex normals during decimation. This acts as a constraint on the decimation and thus the desired face target might not be reached.

exposed_options.name: Preserve Topology
exposed_options.description: Preserves topological features like holes during decimation. This acts as a constraint on the decimation and thus the desired face target might not be reached.
